question: According to the Women's Reservation Bill, 2023, how many seats in the Lok Sabha and state legislative assemblies are reserved for women?
solution:
The correct answer is __**one-third**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **One-third** of the seats in the Lok Sabha and state legislative assemblies are reserved for women according to the Women's Reservation Bill, 2023.
 
• The bill aims to enhance women's representation in legislative bodies, promoting gender equality in political participation.
 
• This reservation will be applicable for a period of 15 years from the commencement of the act.
 
• The seats reserved for women will be rotated after every general election to ensure a fair representation across different constituencies.
 
• This initiative is seen as a significant step towards empowering women and ensuring their active involvement in the legislative process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Women's Reservation Bill was first introduced in 1996 and has seen several revisions before its passage in 2023.
 
• India has a history of women leaders in politics, including Indira Gandhi, the first female Prime Minister, and Pratibha Patil, the first female President.
 
• Women's representation in local governance has been mandated since the 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendments, which reserve one-third of seats in Panchayats and Municipalities for women.
 
• The bill is expected to pave the way for more women to take on leadership roles and influence policy-making at the national and state levels.
 
• Globally, several countries have implemented similar reservations or quotas to boost women's representation in politics.
